description.value: The ground on which you stride is mere fuel that you burn with unholy void energies, scarring the earth in your wake. When a holy creature or psychopomp ends its turn within 10 feet of you, it takes @Damage[(1+max(1,floor((@actor.level -2)/4)))[spirit]] damage. If it's a holy living creature, it takes an additional @Damage[(1+max(1,floor((@actor.level -2)/4)))[void]] damage. At 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the spirit and void damage each increase by 2. Corrupted Ground lasts for 1 minute, but you can Dismiss it.
